title: Numerators and denominators
subtitle: Explore the idea with a visual model.
learning_objective: Explain the job of each number in a fraction.

sections.heading: Make sense of it
sections.body: In 3/5, the numerator 3 counts selected parts. The denominator 5 tells the size of the parts by showing how many equal parts make one whole.

sections.heading: Build a picture
sections.caption: Each row represents the same-sized whole.

sections.problem: In 4/7, identify the numerator and denominator.
steps: Read the top number: 4 is the numerator.
Read the bottom number: 7 is the denominator.
Say it as four out of seven equal parts.
sections.reasoning: Each step keeps the meaning of the whole and its equal parts clear.

sections.heading: Watch for this
sections.body: The denominator does not count only the shaded parts.

sections.heading: Your turn
sections.prompt: Which number is the denominator in 2/9?
sections.hint: Use the visual and the worked steps above before choosing.
